status: Declared before this follow-up execution, hypothesis chosen after original return and critic controls; not independent preregistration.
population: Same six archived integer-output programs; six correlated leave-one-out/order robustness conditions, not independent production tasks.
algorithm: Unmodified snapshot src/residual.py learn; generic exact Hankel/weighted-automaton refinement, no source-family fit. IDs remapped to local ranks to preserve declared teacher ordering despite learn sorting IDs.

initial_acquisition.seed_tests: all five empty-output tests plus (local0, first alphabet symbol=-8)
initial_acquisition.cache: Acquired once per ordering, serialized and cloned identically into both paired extension arms; no sixth-teacher measurement before extension.

primary_arms.cache_only: all six empty-output tests plus identical initial anchor (local0,[-8]); exact initial measurement cache reused.
primary_arms.retained_tests: actual serialized learned initial tests plus new local5 empty-output test; exact same initial cache reused. No extra sixth-teacher first-symbol anchor.

cold_reference: Fresh-all-six with empty cache and same generic seeds/anchor; stage-two workload alone. Also report initial acquisition + fresh all-six for whole two-stage lifetime.
ordinary_reference: Learn each of six programs separately through unchanged generic learner, empty-output plus own first-symbol test. For each ordering count initial five modules, new sixth module, and all-six lifetime. No family-aware coefficients/configurations enter acquisition.
known_family_boundary: Original availability-aware public-family fitter used only existing public calibration and zero new teacher calls. Retain this as a strong boundary, not learned structure or a substitute for paid/native acquisition evidence.
development: Unchanged run_experiment.development() (seed6701); never include later words or evaluator configurations in learner arguments.
validation: After each fit, exact evaluator reference certificate with remapped configurations; all finite words over declared alphabet within reference semantics. Read-only later_words()[-128:] output checks; never fed into fitting. Source-reference validity remains separately scoped to archived programs/family.
costs: Persist every newly executed teacher query with original/local teacherID, sourceSHA, word, value and sequence. Report teacher calls, symbols, cache hits, arithmetic/elapsed, and initial+extension lifetime; verification/reference execution costs/time separately disclosed. No real-world timing/speed claim.
controls: No extra sixth anchor or failed-readout measurements in primary paired arms; no automatic retries, favorable-order selection or family-specific learning. All six declared results, including failures/negative savings, retained.
concurrency: One offline process, serial fitting; no model calls, network, account mutation or maintained edits.
